description.value: The Firewood Café is a family-owned Mount Pleasant institution that has been crafting hand-tossed, thin-crust pizzas in a firewood brick oven since 1989. Located at the corner of 14th and Cambie, it offers a broad menu of classic and creative pizzas alongside made-to-order pasta dishes. Cyclists can grab a quick pickup order or settle in at one of the small number of dine-in tables.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (8 spaces, covered) at 34m; stands (2 spaces) at 63m; stands (2 spaces) at 80m; stands (4 spaces) at 96m. Total: 16 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the OSM phone number (604 873 0001), address (3004 Cambie @ 14th, Vancouver BC), and URL. The site explicitly lists pickup and delivery options, a dedicated vegetarian pizza section, and dine-in seating. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or device charging appears anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Established, actively operating restaurant with pickup and dine-in options on a major Vancouver cycling corridor (Cambie Street); a practical food stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website has a dedicated 'VEGETARIAN PIZZAS' section including Classic Veggie, Greek, and Spanako options; no vegan or GF claims found
